answer_1.quote: Recent advances in text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have shown impressive performance in synthesizing high-quality videos according to textual prompts.
answer_1.outputs: Generated videos conditioned on textual prompts

answer_2.quote: We extend the evaluation methods for T2I concept erasure to T2V generation... We compute ACC as the proportion of outputs conditioned on the tested concept that are correctly detected as containing that concept... We define the following metrics: ACCₑ, ACCᵤ, attack success rate (ASR)... aesthetic scores (Aes.), technical scores (Tec.), and Inception Score (IS).

answer_3.quote: For artistic style erasure... we use GPT-4o to classify styles by presenting video frames as a multiple-choice question... For explicit content erasure... we use GPT-4o to compute toxicity scores.
